svg.text: OS process architecture with the multiprocess executor — structural view, not execution order
PINNED commit 4c2d277643e2 · DP=1 · PP=1 · TP=N · one GPU per worker rank
3 process roles · N+2 OS processes total
optional torch_shm tensor IPC for MM payloads
owns request lifecycle and CPU scheduling state
broadcast RPC MessageQueue + per-worker response MQs
No model weights or GPU KV cache live here; those are worker-owned.
N INDEPENDENT OS PROCESSES · ONE PER TP RANK / GPU
multiprocessing Pipes: READY + MQ handle · parent-death EOF
GPU tensor collectives for tensor-parallel model shards
rendezvous: file store; loopback TCP store when required
Frontend → core: EngineCoreRequest / abort / utility control, msgpack-encoded; optional out-of-band torch shared-memory tensors for multimodal data.
Core → workers: collective RPCs; inference carries SchedulerOutput. Workers → core: status + result; the selected output rank returns ModelRunnerOutput.
Worker ↔ worker: device tensors only through the initialized TP distributed group; frontend and EngineCore do not join that GPU collective group.
Code anchors · vendored files at the pinned commit
Scope excludes DP coordinator / Ray / multi-node paths (DP=1, one-node case).
